decisions.reason: As a 2023 addition squarely within the firm's compact construction equipment range, it still fits the established engineering, sales and service setup and shows no clear sign that would justify an early withdrawal.
The articulated construction dumper remains close to the firm's core business and should continue to benefit from its existing customer base, product know-how and aftersales capabilities.
The material lift line is supported by explicit evidence of strong market acceptance and a large order, so discontinuation within a year appears very unlikely.
Although this underground mining loader is farther from the firm's established range, the reported heavy early usage indicates real customer value, making continuation more likely than withdrawal.
